title: KATSEYE · Gabriela
description: The complete 90s Latin telenovela music video: Gabriela Enterprises skyscraper, mahogany CEO boardroom, sunlit and midnight-blue Venetian blinds, crimson conference-table choreography, peach mansion ballroom, rose-arch wedding crash, 90s "KATFIGHT" talk-show stage with rose petals, and neon outro. Original music with three physical mouth-engine voices.

parts.name: CEO Gabriela · physical airway
parts.role: Opening boardroom monologue & closing wine-desk outro

melody.name: Gabriela
melody.lyrics: Gabriela. Against all odds, I have built and sustained this empire over the last twenty years. A miracle, truly. No thanks to any of you. I would love to say that my legacy is in capable hands. But alas, the talent in this room is quite disappointing. However, one of you must succeed me and claim my name as the next CEO of Gabriela Enterprises. So who will be the next Gabriela? Ladies, ladies, ladies, silence! It's nice to see a competitive spirit. May the best Gabriela win. Today's show is more chaotic than KATSEYE. So let's build that peace! Build that peace right there! Cheers!
